title: Your Phone Replaces ID In 20 States—But Not Most
hook: Only 20 states accept phone IDs at airport security.
closing: Digital IDs are spreading, but travelers still need plastic backup across most states.
question: Have you tried a digital ID?

segments.say: Airport security accepts phone IDs from 20 states, nearly doubling earlier coverage.
Digital-ID checkpoints reached 250, making phone verification available in far more airport lines.
Digital IDs work in 20 states, so most travelers still need plastic identification.
